The image displays a dried, withered leaf that is brown and curled. The leaf appears to be dying from the tip downwards, a classic symptom of Die Back disease, which involves the progressive death of twigs, branches, or in this case, a leaf from the tip inward. There are no signs of powdery white spots (Powdery Mildew), black sooty mold (Sooty Mould), or distinct dark lesions typical of Anthracnose.
